notes.title: Major Update 2021!
notes.content: Lots of graphical and technical updates on all the levels! Adjusted difficulty levels and improvements!

notes.title: New Episode: Chinese New Year (15 new levels)
notes.content:
It´s time to celebrate Chinese New Year! Take pandas home for CNY dinner in these 15 new levels - FREE in the full version of Elephant Express VR.

Sneak Peek Preview Video is available in the Videos Section.

If you have the full version, just use Steam client on your PC to download the latest update and start playing the Chinese New Year levels.

DEMO VERSION is also updated to the latest version (1.04) and brings some bug fixes. Demo version only includes three free levels (one on each first three episodes) and the tutorial. So in order to play full episodes, you have to get full version.

More episodes coming later. Suggest us if you have great ideas for the future themes!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155950/89c443f9c4a6d06ba330e6394a0962b36d2ff9f6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: FREE DEMO now available!
notes.content:
You can now download a FREE demo version of the game!

DEMO includes:
- 3 FREE levels!
- Tutorial level
- Introductions and game menu

FREE LEVELS are:
- Tutorial Level
- Episode 1 Level 1 (Mail for Hippos)
- Episode 2 Level 2 (Night Shift)
- Episode 3 Level 3 (Cave Expedition)

FULL VERSION will get you all the Episodes and Levels, including upcoming Chinese New Year special episode (15 new levels, January 2017)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155950/3467a3969b51478d4f414679153b1e3347ad5736.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Happy Holidays & Update version 1.035
notes.content:
Happy Holidays everyone!

Latest Update (to version 1.035) brings some graphics quality upgrades together with bux fixes and performance improvements.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155950/4c97d64bdb4ac92b6e66d6f66af5c8b7ceea0fcf.jpg[/img]

Make sure you play the latest version of the game by enabling Auto Updates on your Steam Client! (or update manually if you like).
